selection: Regression validation MSE; binary validation Brier separately. Prefer the simplest candidate whose paired block/day 95% loss-difference interval includes zero relative to the best validation candidate. Calibration uses its separate partition. No automatic promotion.
learning_curves: Chronological training-session prefixes 25/50/100 percent evaluated only on validation, never repeated final-test tuning
recent_target_exclusion: Exclude target observation ID, source-record ID and any declared shared sample-unit ID. Require completed receipt/review before issue.
serving_incumbent: Full-face suitable-space incumbent currently abstains; A_reference is the compatible simple training reference, not a relabeling of the meter-panel artifact
movement: Validation-only D plus actual observed arrivals/departures, window and coverage indicators. No inferred movements from snapshot differences.
